scope: Validates the VR chain (controller pose -> mapping -> IK -> joint targets -> simulated TCP) in simulation. Real-machine behavior was confirmed on site by the user; the adapter's Dora VR dataflow remains a structural template (real lite-vr path is zenoh/TCP).

commands.fake_headset_rotation: python3 fake_headset_rot.py --amp-deg 20 --period 6 --duration 12 (90 Hz, right controller yaw)

translation_run.axis_mapping: hand +x -> robot +x; hand +z -> robot -y (matches translation_remap applied as its transpose: rel = M.T @ hand_delta)

rotation_run.sign: opposite to hand yaw, consistent with rotation_signs[1] = -1
